tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa rin po che rang byung rdo rje rnam par thar pa tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so//

༄༅// "$ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa bla med thub pa che// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag sems dpa' rmad byung dang*// snyigs dus 'gro ba kun la lam ston pa// rmad byung de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag rjes bzhugs mos pa'i blo ldan pa// rab byung rdo rje zhes bya rang nyid kyis// rnam thar gzhan la sgrogs pa'i phyir min gyi// gzhan gyi bskul ba phyogs tsam bri bar bya/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la lhag byas pas/ thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan la dad par 'gyur/ dge ba'i sa bon byang chub myu gu grub// rjes dpag rtags kyi mngon sum bzhin du snang*// re shig bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa ni// chung ngu'i dus na 'das pa'i rmi lam ltar// cung zad gsal ba ngag du brjod 'gyur pa// gzhan gyi gtam du brjod gyur pa// gzhan gyi gtam du brjod pa lta bur 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu grub kyis// slob ma pradzña a la ka zhes pa// rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs shing rab byung nas// ngo bo gnyis med smra la dad par gyur// grub thob chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje yis// rjes su 'jug pa ka ma la dhe nu// de'i gzhung lugs mthong bar gyur pa na// de ni kho bos sngon tshe byas snyams byed// 'dzam gling lho phyogs char byung pa'i// dharma bho dha zhes bya thugs rje'i// mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs pas// de 'drar gyur te snyam pa yang yang dran// zhi ba mtsho dang slob dpon pad+ma yis// slob ma btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs ni// pad+ma dbang chen mngon du grub gyur pa// de ni rmi lam bzhin du dran par gyur// de'i 'og tu nub phyogs grong khyer spyod// yang ni dbus kyi sa char byung gyur pa// sne zur pa dang kha rag sgom chung gis// chos 'brel ldan snyam da lta don kun shes// rin chen gsal zhes bya bar gyur pa snyam// chung ngu'i dus su de skad smras pa yin// rgyal ba'i sras po ma pham sras gyur pa// seng ge'i rnam 'phrul dharma ghit+ti ste// dus gsum mkhyen zhes 'jig rten snyan pas khyab// de yis byin brlabs rnam 'phrul sprul pa bzhin// de nas byang phyogs so la mtha' ru spyod// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba rgya cher mdzad// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan karma pa// de'i byin brlabs rgyud la zhugs pa las// deng sang karma pa'i mtshan sgrogs shing*// zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa gsum par gyur// kye ma deng sang dus na mgu dka' bas// gzhan las nges pa'i shes pas bskyed bya'i phyir// bar do'i shes pa stod lung 'phar tshang du// 'jug tshul bstan kyang las kyi 'phro med cing*// bstan cing mi rnams dga' ba bskyed pa dang*// bdag nyid chen po o rgyan pa la smras// mtha' bral 'das pa'i sa phyogs skyes snyam tshe// rang snang 'khrul pa bar do'i snang ba la// zhing skyongs rnams kyis bskul bar byed mthong nas// drin las brjod cing 'dzam gling skye bar bskul// bar do'i snang bar 'khor lo sdom pa yi// drug cu rtsa bzhi dkyil 'khor dbang bskur nas// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bkra shis brjod pa thos// rdo rje theg pa snyigs dus 'dul ba bsnyams// snye nam phyogs su nye bar gyur pa rnams// sna tshogs 'ja' mtshon 'khrigs pa'i lam la phyin// shel gyis khang par rin chen them skas can// de ru zhugs snyam bar do'-i snang ba yin// kye ma mngal nas mun rum nag po rus// las kyis gnas pa'i 'gro rnams sdug bsngal zhing*// dbang med mi dran nyon mongs gnas pa yin// bdag ni skyabs gnas shes bzhin du// 'das pa'i rab dang bar do'i snang ba dag

/phyogs tsam nges pa'i rim pa brjod pa'o// ༈ dpal ldan karma'i rnam thar las// ma 'ongs sprul pa'i 'byung lugs lung bstan pa// kho bo 'di 'og dga' ldan gnas 'gro ste/ bdag nyid chen po byams pa'i gsungs rab 'dzin// 'brel bar ldan rnams phal cher der skye bas// ma pham pa la gsol ba thob ces gsungs// gdul bya'i gtso bo 'ga' zhig shar phyogs kyis// lus 'phags kyis gling du skye bas des rnams kyis// don du sprul pa gcig byung skye bo rnams// yang dag lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin// byang phyogs 'jig rten gling sems can la// phan phyir 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs 'dzin pa// pad+ma rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i// 'byung bar gyur te de sogs mang du 'byung*// yang ni lug lo zla ba dang po la// nyams kyi snang bar la stod dpal thang gis// dkyil na rnal 'byor mid la ras pa ni// phyag na thod pa bdud rtsis bkang bsnams nas// rnam 'phrul 'gyed cing ma 'ong 'phrin las 'byung*// gsung pa gzigs te bstan chos mdzad pa yod// de nas rang byung zhes bya ba bdag kyang ni// karma pa zhes grags pa'i rgyal sras kyis// thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs shing bskul ba las// mid la'i 'khrungs pa tsa phu zhes bya ba// zhur mo'i gang 'gram skye ba'i tshul bzung ngo*// de nas sprel lo'i zla ba dang po la// rje btsun dam pa'i bzhugs nas nye ba ru// tshes brgyad yar gyi ngo la babs pa ni// skyes nas srid dang mthun par lung snang ngo*// skye ba'i sdug bsngal myong yang dran ma nyams// dbang po ma nyams yid kyang g.yo ba med// zla ba mthong nas yid kyang mgu bar gyur// tshig brjod shes kyang ma brjod rin chen gnas// de nas bzungs ste lo lnga'i bar du ni// byis pa'i spyod pas gnas par gyur mod kyang*// snang ba thams cad rmi lam 'drar shes shing*// rmi lam na yang dag snang du ma byung*// khyad par du yang nub gcig rmi lam na// rin chen shel gyis gdan khri rgyab yol bcas// de steng rang lus sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs 'dug

/kha dog lnga ldan 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// nam mkha'i dkyil nas bya bzhin kun tu rgyu// lha min dpag med mchod cing phyag 'tshal mthong*// re shig glang 'khor spyi mchod phyin pa'i tshe// dam pa'i sku de 'ja' mtshon lta bu la// 'od byung bdag la thim pa lta bur snang*// de nas pha las zhi byed so lugs dang*// rgyud kyi bka' babs lnga po mnos pa yin// sngags 'chang ngos nag pa dang dbu rtse pa// de dag la ni ma phur bka' lung thob// gar song phyogs rnams kun tu byis pa dang*// skye bo rnams la chos rnams rtsed mos bstan// yi ge 'bri 'don chos kun mthong tsam gyis// bslab ma dgos par shes shing rtogs par 'gyur// mkhas btsun dam pa gser khang pa yi ni// bdag la gus mdzad dris par gyur pa las// bar do'i rnam thar brjod par grags pa yin// skye drongs 'phags pa'i drung du phyin pa'i tshe// spyan ras gzigs kyis bdag la byin brlabs nas// gzhan phan 'byung snyam dga' ba rgya chen skyes// snying rje'i dam bcas nye 'don byed par 'gyur// sngon gyis smon lam stobs kyi rab bskul nas// dpal ldan o rgyan pa'i drung du phyin// skyes chen de yis rmi lam mtshan gcig tu// karma pa byon gsungs gleng byung pa las// phyi nang bdag 'ong mkhyen nas bsu ba btang*// 'dus pa'i dbus su bdag ni ltos med phyin// sngon gyi tshig brjod khyod kyis bla ma mdzod// bdag ni bsod nams tshogs kyi rtsal rdzogs kyang*// 'byung bzhi ma rdzogs khyed kyi bskyang du gsol// bdag nyid che des brtse ba'i bu bzhin bskyangs// dge bsnyen byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed dang*// dril bu pas mdzad 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// ma phur dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par bskur// dgyes mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba dus 'khor dang*// 'byung po 'dul byed rgyud kun rdzogs par gsungs// ro snyoms sgang dril sku gsum ngo sprod dang*// bsre 'pho khrid chen brgyad kyi khrid ka dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho do ha skyes sbyor dang*// gzhan yang chos phran mang du gnang bar mdzad// phyis dus bsrungs bzlog rdzas sgrub du ma dang*// bsnyen bsgrubs gzhung phran la sogs rnams kyang gnang*// de nas bdag ni lo bdun lon pa'i tshe// mkhan po chen po kun mkhyen shes rab la// rab tu byung zhing bslab tshigs kun kyang nyan// yang dag blangs pa'i yon tan bcas par gyur// de dus bshes gnyen gnyan ras dag la// spyan ras gzigs kyi byung nas kyang*// bstod tshig bcas pa'i pho nya legs btang nas// bdag drung yon tan bsngags pa mdzad par gyur// la stod grod lung zhes byas phyin pa na// u rgyan ghu rus dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe// bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog nyid du mthong*// lhan cig skyes pa'i byin brlabs brtan par 'gyur// snye nams dben gnas phyin tshe dag snang la// rgod tshangs pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor don// bla mas bstan ltar bsam pa'i snang ba 'byung*// de ni bla ma'i byin brlabs brda ru go

/de dus phyi rol yul rnams shel lta bu// ma bsgribs bsal ba'i snang ba skabs su byung*// ngag tu brjod pas bla ma'i zhal snga nas// bar chad rgyu yin gzhan la ma smra gsung*// la stod pu trar tho rangs dus gcig tshe// dpal ldan mgon po sngags kyi bdag po gnyis// gsal bar snang zhing mtshur phur myur du 'dengs// zer ba'i snang ba yun ring gsal bar snang*// bla ma'i chags phyir 'ong pa'i lam du ni// dag snang du ma 'char tshul mang byung zhing*// khyad par ldan lar gsang bdag nges shes kyis// mi ma yin rnams 'dud par gyur snyams byed// mtshur phu'i gdan sar bla ma gnyan ras drung*// sa ra ha la brgyud pa'i tshogs kyi skor// mkha' la yun ring bar du gsal bar snang*// brgyud pa'i gdams pa gzhan la phan par go /gzhan yang dben par bsil ba'i chu mig dag /smon pa bzhin du sngags kyis bdag pos phul// de tshe yal ga skam po btsugs pa las// lo ma phun gsum tshogs pa skye bar 'gyur// bkra shis gsar mar dar ma sgang pa yis// byin brlabs zhus tshes bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// mkha' la byon snyam gzhan dag dad pa skyes// mos gus che ba'i rgyu mtshan yin pa snyam// yang ni gnas der dpal ldan mgon po dang*// lha mo'i snang ba gsal bar shar nas kyang*// bstod pa'i dbyangs dang tshigs su bcad pa byas// rta'i lo la sa g.yos mang byung tshe// chos rnams rang gis sems kyi cho 'phrul du// shar zhing de'i nges shes bstan par gyur/ de dus rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa// me dpung 'bar ba lta bu yun ring snang*// de'i 'khor du ma hā ka la ni// nyi ma'i gzi ldan snang ba yun du byung*// shing rta can gyi rje gnang byin pa'i tshe// lcang lo can gyis bkod pa snang bar gyur// las mgon rnams kyis de'i bka' 'khor du// sprin nag rlung gis bskyod pa ltar snang byed// re shig dpal ldan lha mo dung skyongs ma// re ma ti dang 'khor mor bcas pa rnams// mtshur phu'i gnas 'dir chos khrims gyis cig zer// snyam byed bstod pa brjod cing de ltar byas// de bzhin rab rib 'khrul pa'i rmi lam du// dpal gyi ri la sa ra ha pa yis// rang sems bla ma dam par bstan pa dang*// do ha'i don rnams blo la gsal bar gyur// paṇa tsi ka dang bsdud pa'i bshad sbyar gnyis// shes rab dpal la lan gcig thos pas go

/dgyes pa rdo rje ti kar bcas pa dang*// spyod 'jug rnam bshad chos phran du ma zhig dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya la legs par thos// khyung rdzong 'dug tshe rin chen ri bo la// spyan ras gzigs dbang kha sar pa ṇi bzhugs// mdun na ngan 'gro'i gnas snang thugs rje yis// 'od zer 'gyed par byed pa'i rmi lam mthong*// brgyud pa'i khrid ka chos drug bsre ba gsum// ka dpe tshig bcad tshig lhug zhal gdams dang*// lhan cig skyes ma ku ru ku le dang*// man ngag tshigs bsdus gang gā ma dang ni// lta ba mdor bsdus thog babs rdo skor dang*// blo sbyongs lam rim chos bzhi nad 'don gsum// khams gsum ma dang phag mo'i phran 'ga' dang*// 'di rnams mid la dwags po'i gdams pa yin// do ha skor gsum thun 'jog sham bu can// rgyal ba rgya mtsho mkha' 'gro thugs bsgrubs dang*// gtum mo rnams gsum khyung gi sham bu can// phag mo bde mchog rig 'dzin sham bu can// thabs bzhi chos 'khor chos drug sham bu can// bsre ba dgu bskor ro snyoms sham bu can// sde brgyad gnad 'khor log tri'i sham bu can// tshe bsgrubs rnam gsum tshar gsum khug pa dang*// bsnyen bsgrubs phyag rgya rnam gsum don khrid dang*/ gzer lnga gegs sel lus med chos skor dgu// ras chung nas rgyud gdams pa'i gtso bo yin// rnam bzhi rgyud 'grel 'brel pa gsum ldan dang*// zhal bzhi ma dang snying 'phrog khros ma dang*// phag mo rgya mtsho zhes bya'i bsgrubs thabs brgyad// gzhung drug 'od kyis 'phreng ba'i cha lag dang*// thugs rje chen po rgyud bzhi bsgrubs thabs bcas// gsungs bsgrubs dong sprug snang ba lam khyer dang*// lha sa ma dang dpal mo yid bzhin 'khor// mi tra las brgyud dmar po rtsa ba dang*// don zhags cod pan la sogs du ma dang*// bde khros rgyud gnyis bsgrub thabs rnam pa gsum// drag po gsum skor gsang bsgrub gnubs kyi lugs// drag po gsum 'dul me lce'i bsgrubs pa dang*// rnam 'joms rigs gsum la sogs phyag rdor skor// 'jam dpal dkar dmar ser po'i bsgrub thabs dang*// sgrol ma brgya rtsa seng lding nags sgrol dang*// ku ru ku le'i rtogs pa bsgrubs skor ni// bhe ro las brgyud gter ma gnyis ka dang*// dkar mo'i tshe bsgrubs la sogs sgrol ma ste// bde mchog lo hi pa dang dril bu'i skor// bcu gsum pa dang la ba bcu gsum gnyis// mar do pu rangs brgyud pa thams cad dang*// phag mo shwa ba ri las byung ba drug

/byang chub shing lo mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rin chen rnam pa bdun// nges brjod bong zhal can dang lhan skyes brjod// bong zhal can dang lha lnga gsum// yig bdun rigs gsum lhan skyes bsgrubs thabs gnyis// nag po'i gzhung drug nag chung phran drug dang*// dgyes rdor dpa' gcig lha lnga drug cu bzhi// rig bsdus bsgrub thabs rdzogs rim bcas pa rnams// rtsa rgyud kun spyod ra la'i rgyud rnams dang*// rta mgrin thugs dril rgyud dang bsgrubs pa dang*// lha lnga dpa' gcig me'i phreng ba dang*// pad+ma dbang chen rtsa ba la sogs dang*// yang dag rtsa ba phur pa rtsa thung dang*// khu byug rol pa phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud// phyag rgya chen po theg le rgyud drug dang*// dgongs 'dus kun byed brag skor rgyud bdun dang*// snga 'gyur lnga dang phyi 'gyur bcu gsum dang*// rin spungs klongs phrin gu ru zhi ba dang*// snying thig zab mo pod bzhi khrid kar bcas// myang dang chos dbang rgyud pa'i gter chos phal// blo ldan mchog sred rgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang*// phyag bzhi'i rgyud dang bsgrubs thabs bcu tsam dang*// stag zhon rgyud dang sgrubs thabs ma lus dang*// mtsho skyes ma dang bse gdong trag shad dang*// beng dang ber nag can gyi bsgrubs skor dang*// lha mo rgyud bcu bsgrubs thabs bcas pa dang*// dpon g.yogs gsum ma bsgrubs dang pad+ma yis// re ma ti yi bsgrubs thabs cha lag bcas// de sogs drag sngags bsgrubs thabs skor mang po dang*// dbang dang byin brlabs bka' dang bcas pa rnams// bla ma gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum la rgyud// ri khrod dbang phyug gnam mtsho ba la ni// bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba bshad bcas dang*// zhu lan mun sel dgongs pa lung ston dang*// ma gcig las rgyud chos rnams ma lus dang*// zab gdams skor lnga chos rje'i chos chung rnams// zhi byed don rgyud phag mo gzhung drug dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho skor gsum thog babs dang*// gzhan yang gdams phran bka' lung bcas pa thob/

rdzogs pa chen po snying thig zhus pa'i tshe// mngon gsum rig pa'i tshad la 'bebs pa yi// rmi lam shar shing man ngag zab par rtogs// gzhan las phan par gyur pa'i ltas kyang snang*// dpal ldan karma pa'i gdan sar 'gro ba'i ltas// chos skyongs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun// brgyan dang na bza' mdzes pa gsol nas kyang*// glu dbyangs snyan pa'i sa bon gzhan phan 'byung bar go /jo mo'i gang du zla gcig bsdad pa'i tshe// gdams pa 'ga' zhig gdan sa pa la bshad// dpal ldan lha mos 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang*// mos par ldan pa'i rten 'brel 'ga' zhig mthong*// mkhan po chen po gzhon nu byang chub dang*// slob dpon chen po dge 'dun rin chen la// bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bco brgyad lo la byas// 'di las dam chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi// mdo rtsa lnga bcu pa dang gsum brgya pa// karma sha tam lo yi dri ba gnyis// so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa rnam pa gsum// mdo chung bzhi dang gdams ngag dang*// sman lha mdo bsgrub sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis// gzhan yang gdams phran bcas pa legs par thos// bshes gnyen dam pa shākya gzhon nu la/ byams pa'i chos lnga 'grel par bcas pa dang*// dbu ma rtsa ba'i ga la 'jigs med dang*// rang rgyud shar gsum dgongs pa'i rnam pa lnga// dgongs 'grel sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel dang*// rnam par mi rtog 'jug pa'i 'grel pa dang*// sgom rim rnam gsum jo bo'i chos chung dra ba la// mngon pa gong 'og 'grel bshad bcas pa dang*// bslab btus mdo sde kun las btus pa dang*// tshad ma kun las btus dang rtsa 'grel dang*// rig sgo sde bdun dmigs pa brtags pa dang*// 'dul ba 'od ldan chos mchog chung ngu dang*// nyi khri snang ba shes snying 'grel pa dang*// de sogs lung rnams legs par thob pa yin// gzhan yang rdzogs chen gsang skor ngo sprod dus// stong 'jug rdo rje 'chang sogs snang ba shar// de nas dpal ldan karma'i yang dgon du// nam langs dus mthar 'od kyis mdzes pa'i nang*// bhi ma mu trar rab gsal mdzod spur thim// rdzogs chen don rnams shin tu gsal bar gyur// bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// mjal zhing chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe// byang chub sems dpa' du ma'i dag snang dang*// 'phrin las ltas kun sems la gsal bar snang*// de nas lha steng dben gnas 'debs pa'i tshe// rgyal ba'i ring bsrel du ma rmi lam snang*// 'ga' zhig 'od 'bar 'ga' zhig 'od mi gsal// bsam gtan brten pa 'byung ba'i tshul du go

/gzhan yang dben par 'dug pa'i rmi lam na// nub phyogs zhing khams gcig tu phyin pa las// sa yi mthil mnyam rin chen mchod brten bskor// bde ba can zhes grags pa'i sgra yang thos// re zhig ri bo 'dzin pa'i steng du phyin// shākya'i rgyal po 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs pa'i// 'khor gyi bskor tshul chos tshul dris pa las// mdo sde rmi lam nang mthong dris pa yin// re zhig lhun po'i steng na khang stegs drung*// bshes gnyen gsum gyi byams chos gsal bar gsungs// sad kyang blo la gsal snang de phyin chad// byams chos don rnams legs par go bar byung*// de 'og rin chen gser gyis brag ri'i steng*/ spyan ras gzigs kyis phyag nas bdud rtsi'i chu// bab snang shel gyi phor pas bcus 'thung nas// lhag ma sems can gzhan la bkye ba rmis// kun tu spyod pa'i 'grel pa byed pa'i tshe// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rin chen du ma rnams// bdag la byin rmis rgyud don zab mo rnams// rin chen bzhin du dgos 'dod 'byung bar go /lha steng nags la me chen 'bar 'gyur tshe// du ba'i nang du 'brug dang chu byung zhing*// skad cig me zhi char rgyun phyogs med 'bab// skye bo skrag pa zhi zhing bstod pa brjod// gzhan yang nub gcig 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// zhal gsum phyag drug sprin nag lta bu la// 'bar 'phreng 'khrigs shing sngags ni 'brug ltar sgrogs// gzhan gyis sbod stong bar chad bzlog par mthong*// tshad yul gcong brag ri khar phyin pa'i tshe// kha ba dkar po dge bsnyen dgra 'dul ni// mi rta dkar po dar dkar thog nas kyang*// shar phyogs lha'i khang pa gsal bar bstan// yid 'ong mdzes pa'i rin chen mchod par 'bul// de nas kam po gnas nang du 'gro ba'i dus// rdo rje dpal brtsegs dge bsnyen chen po de// rta dkar rngog dmar zhon cing dar dkar thogs// dga' ba bzhin gyis bsu ba byed pa mthong*// shar phyogs kol ti'i 'khrug pa chen po de// mi ma yin gyi 'khrug pa byung rig nas// ting nge 'dzin gyi zhi bar gtul byas pas/

bka' bzhin bsgrubs zhes snyan par smra ba thos// gnas sgor skye chen dpal ldan o rgyan pa// rma bya'i sgro thogs zhal nas gdams ngag gsung*// snyigs ma'i brda stan me long gzugs brnyan ltar// tho rangs rgyud kyi rmi lam snang ba shar// mdo khams phyogs nas dbus su byon pa'i tshe// gnyan chen thang lha la sogs gzhi bdag rnams// gus pa'i tshul gyi bsu ba byed par gyur// gzhan snang na bun lam la 'khrigs pa snang*// mtshur phur phyin tshe mkha' 'gro chos skyongs rnams// thams cad dgyes zhing gar gyis rnam 'gyur gyis// snang ba snyam du yid la bsam pa dang*// cung zad 'gro la phan pa'i brda ru shar// rin chen gdugs mdzes me tog las grub pa// shākya'i rgyal la lha sar phul ba'i tshe// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kun tu yang*// mchod pa'i snang ba shar zhing spro ba skyes// dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam bshad byas pa'i tshe// yid kyi yul du yi dam snang ba shar// rgyud don byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa ltar// lhad med rang gis rgyud la gsal bar shar// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan o rgyan pa'i// chos kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir// dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' don grub la// dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud 'grel yan lag bcas// sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung po 'dul byed dang*// 'khor lo chen po sdom 'byung rgyud 'grel dang*// gshed mar dgra nag gdong drug rgyud sgrub thabs// rdo rje 'phreng ba mngon 'byung dbang sgrub dang*// gdan bzhi gur dang sam bhu ṭa'i rgyud 'grel// gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang*// gsang snying yang dag lung bzhi mkha' 'gro'i skor/ 'jam dpal sku bsgrubs pad+ma gsung bsgrubs dang*// phur pa'i dbang rdzogs bka' brgyad phal cher dang*// de nyid 'dus pa dpal mchog rig bsdus dang*// rdo rje rtse mo sbyongs rgyud dkyil 'khor rnams// gtsug dgu rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang*// rdo rje bdud rtsi sangs rgyas thod pa dang*// gsang ldan lha mo gcig bsgrubs spyi bsgrubs rgyu dang*// 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud// dbang bka' rgyud 'grel bsgrubs thabs phal cher dang*// sa sde mngon pa gong 'og phung po lnga// theg bsdus skor gsum sum cu pa dang ni// rgyas 'bring rnam gsum 'grel pa 'ga' zhig dang*// dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde lnga bcu dang*/

pad+ma skor gsum la sogs mdo mang zhig /gzungs 'dus rgyas par yod pa ma lus dang*// snyan ngag me long bsdus pa grub mtha' skor// zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma kam lug dang*// lam 'bras dmar zhabs sbyor drug rigs brgyad dang*// gzhan yang gdams phran mang po thos par gyur// gso ba'i gzhung dang gdams pa du ma rnams// rba ras la sogs mkhas pa rnams la thos// khyad par 'byung po 'dul byed thos pa'i tshe// khro bo 'khor bcas rmi lam snang ba la// shin tu gsal mthong bdag la byin brlabs shing*// gsang sngags sgra skad 'brug bzhin sgrogs pa thos// dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud 'grel thos pa'i tshe// bka' srung mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i snang ba dang*// 'jam dbyangs phyag na pad+mo'i byin brlabs pa// phyi nang gsang gsum don rnams gsal bar go /re zhig khyung rdzong dben pa byed pa'i tshe// bla ma grub chen rmi lam byon nas kyang*/ bsnyen bsgrubs rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyis gnad// mngon sum lta bur bstan pa'i snang ba shar// dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen la// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel bshad rgyud bzhi/ 'phags skor cha lag mang du rdzogs pa dang*// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod ma hā ma ya dang*// gur dang gdan bzhi phran rnams ma lus dang*// mes rngog las rgyud dgyes rdor rgya gzhung phal// kha mthun bsgrubs skor gnam lcags ur mo dang*// 'grel pa gru gzings rin chen sna bdun bcas// bde mchog snyan brgyud la sogs mar rngog gis// gdams ngag bsgrub yig bka' lung bcas te thos// gzhan yang 'jam dpal khro bo 'dus pa dang*/ ur mo pa tra bsgrubs yig rgyud rnams dang*// bstan pa bsgrubs byed rgyud dang bsgrubs pa'i thabs// brgya phrag bcu gcig lhag par gyur pa dang*// ro snyoms thub lnga rgyud pa'i gdams phran 'ga'// gzhon nu 'bum zhes bya ba'i brgyud pa yin// de dag dus kyi nyams snang 'ga' yod pas// 'di ru ma bris rang bzhin gnas pa yin// gzhan yang 'grel pa mtha' drug chen po dang*// gsungs gi 'od zer la sogs 'grel pa 'ga'/

'chi med chen po la sogs du ma zhig /dzña na shri zhes bya ba de la thos// snying thig rgyud dang 'grel pa man ngag ni// yi ge'i tshogs dang gsang skor gdams ngag dang*// 'chi med ni gu'i gdams ngag ga'u ma// de sogs gdams ngag ku ma ra dza dang*// ri khrod ras pa las kyang byung ba yod// gzhan yang gangs dkar dben pa byed pa'i tshe// kong po'i yul kun dam chos mos gyur zhing*// gzhan la phan pa'i rmi lam snang ba shar// gzhan la phan pa du ma byung bar gyur// dwags lha sgam po zangs lung ri khrod du// bla ma lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu ni// sa bcu'i dbang phyug de'i 'phrin las su// phyag rgya chen pos gzhan don 'byung bar shar// kong po'i yul gyi mi ma yin pa rnams// chos la gus shing bka' bzhin bsgrub bo zhes// bsgrogs pa'i snang ba shar zhing lo gsum bar// chos bzhin bsgrubs zhing ya mtshan du ma snang*/ tsa ri g.yu mtshor dag snang shar ba dang*// mkha' 'gro'i gnas kyis nges par shar gyur zhing*// rang byung dur khrod dngos grub byung ba dang*// bar chad zhi ba'i snang ba du ma byung*// bkra shis ljongs su gsol ba btab pa'i tshe// mkha' 'gro'i snang ba shar zhing mngon gsum du// mkha' 'gro'i sgra thos byin brlabs zhus pa dang*// ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas kyi khyad par snang*// sham po'i gangs bdun 'khrul pa'i snang ba las// phy-i'i yul dang nang gis rtsa rlung rnams// snang zhing chos rnams kun gyi rten 'brel go /bar chad bzlog cing gzhan phan yi dam bcas// jo mo'i gangs la dben pa byed pa'i tshe// o rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas ni// mkha' la gsal snang byin brlabs zhus pa yis// yid kyi yul du yun ring gsal bar gyur// mtshur phu'i ri khrod skungs stong yod pa'i dus// nang gi rlung dang phyi rol nam mkha' la// gza' dang rgyu skar dus sbyor thams cad kun// gsal bar shar bas rtsis kun snang bar gyur// gsang ba 'dus pa mar lugs nyan pa'i dus// rang gi lus la 'dus pa gsal snang zhing*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa phyi na yod min la// thams cad rang gi sems su nges shes skyes// re shig 'khrul pa'i rmi lam snang ba la// 'di na 'jig rten mang po 'das pa yis// sa na rgyal ba spos glang bzhugs pa yi// dam chos yin zhes pu ti du ma mthong*// gangs dkar chos gtam mang du byas pa'i tshe// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa thams cad gcig pa dang*// yi dam rang gi rig pa'i cho 'phrul du// shes shing byin brlabs rgyud la byung bar go

/gnas der re shig 'jam dpal gzhon nu ni/ byang phyogs 'jig rten mang po na// da ltar sangs rgyas mdzad pa ston pa dang*// yun ring mos pas yid la gsal bar gyur// re shig bdag nyid chen po byams pa'i drung*// sems kyi pad+ma sdong po sprul byas te// gzhan phan bskul ba'i gsol ba btabs pa las// mngon sum bzhin du yid la gsal bar snang*// gangs dkar chos 'byung phug par 'dug pa'i tshe// dpal ldan chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byed snang bas// yid la gsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod// ba tsha phug nag zhes byar 'dug pa'i tshe// mi ma yin rnams bskor zhing phyag 'tshal ba// yid kyi yul du gsal bar gyur pa las/ srog rlung skyon gyi gegs las grol bar 'gyur// chos rje bzhugs gnas gra ma gru bzhi ru// phur pa'i dbang rdzogs la sogs bka' lung rnams// mnos pas de nyid kyi ni snang ba shar// snyigs dus rang gzhan rgyud la cung zad tsam// phan par gyur pa'i dag snang shar nas kyang*// bde chen steng gis ri khrod btabs pa yin// gnas der re zhig 'khrul pa'i snang ba la// rgyal ba'i mchod rten ring bsrel dpag med pa/ dbyibs legs 'od dang ldan pa mang du rnyed// bsam gtan shes rab gzhan la phan pa'i brda'// re shig shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba y-i// zhing na bcom ldan mi 'khrug pa y-i drung*// byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che'i// de'i mdzad la dad cing snang ba gyur// bde chen ri khrod mthon por bsdad pa'i tshe// spyod dang 'od gsal bzhin la bstan pa'i dus// ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du nyams myong dag gnyid dang ma gnyid khyad par med par snang*// kha rag shar gyis ri khrod phyin pa'i tshe// ston zla 'bring po'i nya'i dus mtshams la// o rgyan pad+ma rmi lam snang bar shar// gzhan yang snying khur pad+ma'i phug pa ru// mkha' 'gro'i byin brlabs dag snang shar ba yis// sna tshogs dbyangs dang ngag tu brjod par 'gyur// gzhan yang bden chen dben pa byed pa'i tshe// ston nyams kyis snang bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// sangs rgyas mang snang zhing gi rgyal sras kyis// rnam thar spyod la mos pa rgya chen bskyed// rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems kyi gnad// rgyal ba sna tshogs rgyud la gsungs pa kun// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med pas// mthong nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gcig tu bkod// ngag dang rlung dang yi ge'i rten 'brel ni// mkha' la gser gyis yi ge'i phreng ba rnams// rang gi ba spu'i khur bur thim zhing 'phro// dpal ldan chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral dang*// skyes bu dam can snang ba shar ba yis// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan skabs su babs par gyur// re shig dben pa ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshe// phung po khams sogs gsang 'dus lha tshogs su// rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin// gong nas phyi nang sbyar ba'i bsgrubs thabs byas// re zhig rdo rje sems dpa' he ru kas// byin gyi brlabs pa'i ltas kyi khyad par snang*// phyi rol nam mkhar 'ja' dang 'od du 'khyil// dam tshig sdom pa'i rnam dbye bris pa yin// rmi lam ku ru ku le dbang gi lha// 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing 'du ba can// 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad par snang*// sa ra ha dang dharma kit+ti sogs// mes po'i yid la skabs su snang ba yis/

mkhas grub rnams kyi gzhung don rgya mtsho rnams// rtsol ba med par legs par go bar 'gyur// gangs dkar phug na pad+ma'i sku bzhengs tshe// o rgyan mkhan po'i 'phrin las lhag ma yis// deng sang dus na phyogs rnams thams cad du// 'phrin las cung zad 'grub pa'i snang ba shar// shar gyi phyogs na mi dge spyod pa yi// sems can rnams la phan par bsam pa las// shākya'i rgyal po thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sel ba snyams// mi ma yin pa'i yi dwags rdzu 'phrul can// sha khrag 'dren pa'i rnam pa bzlog nas kyang*// rang gzhan phan par byed par dam bca' bzhin// dad cing rgyal ba'i bstan la gus par byas// gzhan yang rang sems stong pa nyid kyi gzugs// rang rig ye shes bsam gtan snang ba la// dpag tu med pa phar cher 'char mod kyang*// rnam rtog yi ger bris pas ga la langs// re shig dpal ldan sa skyar phyin pa'i tshe// gzhi bdag la sogs mi ma yin pa rnams// dad bzhin dga' ba'i yid kyi 'ong nas kyang*// chos kyi tshul dang mthun par byed pa snyam// tsan brag phyin dus mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gtor ma btang tshe dpal ldan mgon po yis// snang ba yid la yun ring gsal bar 'gyur// bar chod zhi zhing sdong grogs byed pa'i ltas// rgyang khang ur rir 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la// sems bskyed ngo sprod chos rnams bstan pa'i tshe// bla ma brgyud pa'i byin brlabs nyams snang dang*// gzhan snang du yang nyi mar ring bar grags// nyang stod phyogs su gdul bya thams cad la// theg pa sna tshogs chos rnams ston pa dang*// gzhan la phan pa'i rnam grangs mang byung zhing*// dus mtshams zla ba'i 'od zer gsal bar gyur// rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gdul bya mang po la// dag pa'i snang ba 'ga' zhig shar ba dang*// khyad par du yang grags pa seng ge la// nyams kyi snang ba rdzu 'phrul lta bu dang*// re shig snyigs ma'i dus la brten pa dang*// phyi nang bar chod 'ga' zhig 'byung 'gyur pas// de bzlog thabs la brtson par gyis cig ces/

thugs rje'i bdag po'i gsungs sgros gsal ba thos// rgyal ba'i mchod rten zhig pa gsos pa'i tshe// rmi lam snang ba zhing khams 'di nyid du// sna tshogs mchod rten rgyan gyi brgyan par mthong*// ma 'ongs rgyal ba'i mchod rten byed pa snyam// re shig spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi rmi lam ltar// phyi nang bar chad zhi bar mdzad pa dang*// gzhan phan yon tan 'byung ba'i snang ba shar// rgyal ba'i mdo la bsdus don rnams byas shing*// gdul bya'i tshogs la bstan par bya ba'i tshe// rgyal ba'i gsungs tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams kun// zhing khams khyab pa'i stong gzugs snang ba shar// gzhan yang re shig 'brong phu'i gtsug lag lag du// ma pham rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam dbyangs dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs par 'gyur ba la// sna tshogs mchod pa'i khyad par yid yul gsal// de sogs rang byung 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang*// rmi lam bag chags 'khrul snang dkar po yis// sems kyi rnam rtog bris kyis ga la langs// kun gzhi rnam shes sa bon thams cad la// bag chags rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' med pa la// tshogs bdun 'du shes 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// skye zhing 'gag pa'i rba brlabs dpag tu med// de'i snying po brgyad khri bzhi stong chos// rnam par mi rtog zad med nor bu de/ spangs bya gzhan du gnyen po'i yon tan ldan// de yi rnam grangs brjod kyis ga la langs// chos kun ngo bo skye 'gag med pa dang*// sna tshogs ma 'gag shar ba'i rtsal sbyongs zhing*// rang byung ming can yid kyi kun rtogs las// 'di nas ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rnam thar bzhin// ma pham chos kyi bla ma bzhugs pa yin// sna tshogs bkod pa ldan pa'i gnas bzhin du// mdun pas 'phangs te skye bar byed rnams snyam// dpal ldan karma pa'i lung bstan du// ma 'ongs 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i drung*// bdag nyid chen po byams pa'i chos 'dzin pa// rgyud pa 'di las 'byung zhes gang gsung pa// de dang phyogs mthun bdag kyang sbyor 'gyur zhing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod dang mthun par 'jug

/de nas re shig 'od dpag med pa yi// rgyal ba de yi thugs rjes bskul ba dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs/ rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i rnam thar ltar byed cing*// de dag mdzad dang mthun par 'jug par snyam// skal pa bzang po'i rgyal ba rab 'byung ba// de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge nas bzungs te// tha ma snang bar mdzad pa'i bar dag du// chos 'dzin zhing khams sbyongs bar smon lam btabs// thams cad yid kyi gzugs brnyan yin pa'i phyir// de dag rnams kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// rgyal ba'i sras po mthu chen ma smad pa// 'jam dpal gyis ni zhing gis smon lam bzhin// rjes su mthun par yongs su bsgrubs byed cing*// kun tu gzigs pa'i rgyal ba'ang mthong bar 'dod// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis// zhing khams rgya mtsho sbyangs zhing lta ba dang*// rnam thar rgya mtsho'i mdzad pa ji bzhin du// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par// bsgrub par byed pa'i smon lam rab ldan par// dus ring bya dka' sems dpa' med pa dang*// the tshom yid gnyis blo dang bral ba ste// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang mthun par 'jug /'di nas ma 'ongs tshul lugs brjod pa 'di// sems kyi kun rtogs myu gu'i rgyud las ni// rnam dag 'bras bu 'grub phyir bris pa yin// skal ba dman cing brtson 'grus zhan pa dang*// blo chung rnams kyi thos nas the tshom skyes// blo ldan rgyal ba'i snying po la mos pa// theg chen chos tshul rtogs par 'gyur ba rnams// du ba'i rtag la me bzhin nges shes skyes// 'di ni rang byung ma 'ongs spyod pa yin// de ltar 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyis// spyod pa'i tshul rnams yi ger bris pa la// rgya chen don dang ldan pa ma yin kyang*// byis pa'i dus na 'ga' zhig dran pa dang*// la la bstan chos rnams su bris pa'ang yod// gnas skabs spyod dang yid kyi mdun pa dang*// la la rmi lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba ste// de sogs yi ger bris pa 'di dag las// the tshom yid gnyis ldan rnams bzod par gsol// rang gzhan rgyud la gnod par ma gyur cig

/dge ba 'di yi sems can thams cad kyi// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la 'jug par shog /rnam par thar pa tshigs su bcad pa mdor bsdus pa 'di// mkhan chen sa nag pa dang*// sgom pa shes rab rdo rjes gsol ba btabs pa la brten nas/ shing pho byi ba'i lo la bde chen du mdzad pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /chos rje 'di la mos gus gang thob pa// nyi ma'i 'od zer mun pa sel ba ltar// skal par bsags pa'i sgrib pa sna tshogs dag /mchod cing gsol ba thob cig bu slob kun// 'di bris dge ba dri med des// rjes zhugs gsol ba 'debs pa'am// gdul bya bu slob thams cad kun// bla ma'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /sid+dhi// rnam thar tshigs bcad ma'i 'phro 'di chos rje 'dzam gling grags pas mdzad pa'o// ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidhaṃ hūm̐/ lo bzhi bcu yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa brjod zin nas 'dir ni de man chad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis byed pa cung zad brjod par bya'o// bde chen zhes byar bsgrubs pa byed pa'i tshe// nyams kyi snang ba rgyun du shar ba las// snyigs ma'i dus na dben pa ma brten na// bar du gcod pa rnam pa du ma byung*// log pa'i rkyen gyi khrid pa'i skye bo la// rgyal ba'i gsungs bzhin nyams su blangs dgos snyams// de dus rab rib 'khrul pa'i rmi lam na// skyes bu zhig gi 'di skad smra ba thos// dwags kong phyogs kyis gdul bya thams cad las// spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer bkye ba'i phyir/ dpal ldan karma pa'i lung bstan bzhin// 'dul ba'i dus la babs ces thos pa yis// phyogs der phyin zhing 'gro la phan pa byas// nags phu zhes byar dben par 'dug pa'i tshe// rang bzhin ting 'dzin 'phel bar gyur pa dang*// gzhan phan ltas kyi khyad par mang du byung*// dad ldan skye bo rnams kyi mos pa'i sa// lo gcig nang du dgon gnas gtsug lag khang*// mang du thob shing mtha' khob skye bo'i tshogs// gsum la skyabs 'gro byang chub sems dpa' bkod// khyad par pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs pa'i gnas// rkong 'phrang zhes byar dben pa byed pa'i tshe// ting 'dzin shes rab ldan par 'phel 'gyur zhing*// zab mo'i nang don rnam bshad byas pa yin// de'i shar phyogs las kyis gshin rje'i gnas// rgyal bas gsungs pa bzhin du gsal bar mthong*// phrag yul lha khang rab tu gnas pa'i dus// rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlobs pa dang*// chos skyongs rnams kyi ltas rnams mang du mthong*// khyad par tsa ri gnas mdar phyin pa'i tshe// mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab pa// bshes gnyen rnams kyi mthong bzhin dag snang skyes// shin tu bgrod dka'i 'phrang la yongs pa'i tshe// dad par ldan pa'i mi ma yin rnams kyis// gtsang po'i gzhung du bye ma'i lam byas shing*// 'jig rten pa rnams ngo mtshar bskyed par byas// dwags lha sgam po'i gnas su phyin pa'i tshe// bka' brgyud rnams kyis gsal snang du ma dang*// phyi rol du yang me tog char pa babs// gzhan yang yul phyogs de dag thams cad du// chos kyi khri stan rab tu g.yo ba dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las du ma bstan// stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i mar tshes la// lha sar phyin tshe shākya'i rgyal po yis// rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las 'byung ba ltas// mkhas grub rnams kyi so sor mthong bar gyur// de nas dpal ldan karma'i gnas su phyin// gtsug lag khang rnams gso bar byed pa dang*// dad ldan rnams la chos kyis 'khor lo bskor// 'jig rten tshul spangs dben pa brten par bya// ting 'dzin don gnyer brgya phrag du ma byung*// dben par gnas rnams sangs rgyas yon tan bskyed// chos sku'i gnas lugs legs par gsal ba dang*// klu grub dgongs pa ji bzhin rtogs gyur nas// chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa'i rnam bshad byas// de dus 'khrul pa'i nyams kyis snang ba las// dben par gnas rnams sangs rgyas yon tan bskyed// skye bo rnams la 'jigs dang sdug bsngal 'byung*// de nas dben gnas bsgrub par bya'o snyam/

'brug lo zla ba dang po shar ba'i tshe// rmi lam gsal snang du ma shar ba dang*// chos skyong rnams kyi ltas rnams snang ba yin// dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po gnas pa'i sa// sog gis chu la zam pa byed du phyin// klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// bar mchod med par 'phrin las kun grub cing*// gzhan snang ltas kyi khyad par mang du byung*// de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang gis bskul nas// 'jig rten zang zing byas na bar chad byung*// dben gnas gzhan du phyin yang chos mi 'phel// don med phrag dog byed pa mang du byung*// de nas dpal ldan nags phu'i ri khrod song*// zer ba thos nas dben gnas de ru phyin// bar chad med cing ting 'dzin rab tu 'phel// dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyi mi khyab byung*// khyad par du yang nub gcig rmi lam na// shar phyogs rgyal po'i rnam thar sgrogs pa dang*// lo gsum 'das nas khyed kyang 'gro dgos zer// de skad thos nas gdul bya thams cad la// nyams len brtson par gyis zhes bskul ba yin// sbrul lo dbyar gyis nyi ma log pa'i dus// rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum pa las bshad pa// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad rnams kun// mkha' 'gro'i rab tu bstan nas legs par go /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel thams cad kyis// snying po 'jam dpal grags pas legs bsdud pa// rnal 'byor gsum snying rgya cher 'grel par byas// de dus byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang kyis// bla ma rten pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams// yang yang dran nas kun tu bzang po'i// bstod pa byas nas smon lam rgya chen btabs// mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog tsa rir phyin pa'i tshe// bag chags 'khrul pa'i rab rib rmi lam na// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ni// gzhon nu gsum gyis 'di skad gsung pa thos// dben pa brten nas ting 'dzin yon tan 'phel// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la 'gro ba bzhin// gzhan gyis rkyen gyi gsal dang 'grib pa yod// mkha' la rgyu skar rnam par bkra ba yang*// nyi zla'i rkyen gyi gsal dang mi gsal yod/

rang gzhan don la legs par brtags par gyis// brda de bstan nas de nas mi snang gyur// gzhan yang gnas der mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul la// ltas kyi khyad par du ma snang bar gyur// phyi ma'i dus na phan pa'i brdar shar nas// lhun grub steng gi ri khrod btab pa yin// bsgom chen rnams kyis ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*// theg chen rgya mtsho'i rnam thar spel ba'i phyir// phal chen zhing gi bkod pa bstan chos byas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs gis lung bstan ji bzhin du// shar phyogs gdul bya ma lus thams cad la// phan pa'i don du sa bdag rgyal pos bskul// lug lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes drug la// lhun grub nas btegs dbus kyi phyogs su song*// mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog tsa ri rnying ma ru// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i byin brlabs snang ba shar// mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul du ma rnams// sa g.yos sgra skad du ma sna tshogs byung*// dbus phyogs bgrod nas 'dam du sleb pa'i tshe// gnyen chen thang lha la sogs gzhi bdag rnams// ngo mtshar du ma'i cho 'phrul ston byed cing*// dgun gyi nyi ma log pa'i dus tshod la// glog dang 'brug la sogs pa du ma'i sgra// phan gnod ltas kyi bye brag dpag med snang*// res gcig dben pa'i gnas su ting 'dzin spel// spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas// shar phyogs rgyal po'i pho brang lam du phyin// lam du 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang*// theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo yis// sems can 'ga' zhig la ni phan par gyur// rgya bod gnyis kyi mtshams su phyin pa'i tshe// sa bdag pho nyas mgyogs par bskul ba dang*// ltas la brten nas mgyogs par yong mod kyang*// zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes grangs bcu gnyis la// sa g.yos bar du gcod pa'i ltas rnams byung*// gin 'jang hu zhes bya ba'i mkhar du phyin// mi dbang sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i cho ga byas// de dus rmi lam gsal snang 'di ltar byung*// sngon gyi gdul bya rnams kyi don slad du ni// phyin nas sems can rnams la phan par byas// bar du gcod pa gang yang mi 'byung zhing*// khyod kyi bsam pas yongs su rdzogs 'gyur zhes// chos skyong rnams kyi de ltar sgrogs pa thos// myur du rgyal po'i pho brang phyogs su phyin// zla ba bcu pa'i bco brgyad dus tshod la// rgyal po'i pho brang gnas pa'i sems can rnams// dad pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs mchod pa rnams// rin chen gos dang sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin// chos bzang lha rnams legs par bkod 'dra// sna tshogs 'ja' 'od bkra ba'i mdangs gsal zhing*// skye bo rnams la mos pa bskyed par bya// de dus rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// 'phrin las mdzad pa'i snang bar bskyed par byung*// mi dbang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad la// dbang bskur byed tshe 'khrul pa'i snang ba la/

ci ltar byung ba thams cad shes par snang*// de dag gzhan la gsal bar bsgrags pa yin// pho brang chen por cho ga byas pa'i dus// mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul nyams snang la// rin chen dpal zhes grags pa'i rgyal po la// bar chod byung zhes blon po rnams la smras// bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la// mi'i dbang po gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dus// 'jig rten skyongs pa mang po 'dus nas kyang*// dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa nyams la byung*// rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur ba'i brda' ru go /gong ma thal hu rgyal brgyud bcas pa dang*// blon po'i tshogs la dbang bskur chos bshad cing*// rgyal ba'i bstan la cung zad phan par byas// de nas khyi lo zla ba dang po'i tshe// rab rib 'khrul pa'i gnyid kyi rmi lam na// ri khrod nags tshal 'jigs dang bcas pa'i ngogs// mi dkar 'od zer 'phro ba mkha' 'gro yis// mchod pa byed mthong zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ 'di ru ma 'dug gangs can khrod du song*// rang gzhan kun la phan par gyur zhes thos// gong ma rnams la zhu ba byas nas kyang*// khyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i bco lnga la// btegs nas ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas su phyin// 'jam dbyangs byang chub sems dpa' 'phrin las rnams// snyigs dus 'gro la byin gyis brlob pa mthong*// me nyag 'ga'i sa char slebs pa'i tshe// mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul nyams snang dpag med shar// gdul bya rnams la dam chos rgya cher bshad// zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig dus su ni// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyis// gzhan gyi sems rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags// bar snang 'ja' mtshon 'khyil pas gang ba dang*// bka' brgyud bla ma'i nyams snang yun ring byung*// mdo khams shar gyis sa char slebs pa'i tshe// chos skyong rnams kyi 'phrin las du ma yis// 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi bar gyur pa dang*// phal cher byang chub sems la bkod par byas// smar khams sa char phyin pa'i dus su ni// chos skyongs rnams la gtor ma btang ba'i tshe// 'phrin las grub pa'i ltas kyi khyad par snang*// de nas rim gyi karma'i dgon pa dang*// dbus kyi sa char phyin pa'i bar du ni// sems can rnams la phan pa ji rigs byas// bla ma'i tshes gsum mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe// rab rib 'khrul pa gnyid kyi rmi lam na// thang lha gangs dkar la sogs gzhi bdag rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa na bun bzhin du snang*// da rung res gcig shar gyi phyogs rol du// gdul bya rnams la phan par gyur ces thos// bsam yas 'chim phu zhes bya'i ri khrod du// dben pa byed cing zla drug bsdad pa'i tshe// o rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas nyams snang mang du byung*// mkhas btsun rnams la phan pa'i brda ru go

/bar du gcod pa'i ltas dang cho 'phrul rnams// ting nge 'dzin gyi rab tu zhi bar gyur// rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos ma lus pa// bris shing rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i tshe// byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa rnams// thim shing chos sgra sgrogs pa'i snang ba byung*// shing kun chu ma mkhar gyi bar du ni// shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi mthar thugs par// gsal ba'i snang ba yun ring nyams snang byung*// re shig shang to'i mkhar du phyin pa'i tshe// mi dge spyod pa'i sems can mang po la// sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rmi lam snang ba shar// de dag phan phyir spyan ras gzigs dbang la// gsol ba btab pas re shig rmi lam na// mi dkar 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal ba zhig /gong ma rnams dang chos byed skyes bu la// gnod pa gang yang mi 'byung zhes pa thos// glang lo zla ba brgyad pa'i bcu bzhi la// ging mi shan du sa g.yos byung ba'i tshe// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams las// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis// bu slob rnams la bar chad med par byung*// mi dbang blon por bcas pa thams cad la// dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe// khang bzang rin chen sna tshogs yol ba dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i sku dang ni// mkha' 'gro rus pa'-i brgyan can du ma rnams// gar gyi nyams dgu mdzes pa'i yol ba can// gsal snang yun ring bar du gsal bar gyur// gzhan gyis rgyud la phan pa'i brda' ru go /pho brang chen po ta'i tu'i grong khyer mthil// mi dbang lung gis gzhal yas khang ltar gnang*// gong ma rgyal sras sku tshe bsring ba dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa yun ring du// dkyil khang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs// g.yas g.yon zur khang bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yar slongs bzhengs// gzhan yang thub pa'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa dang*// mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs log la bris// mgon po ber nag lha mo g.yog 'khor dang*// rgyal chen sde bzhi chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams// bzhengs nas legs grub rab tu gnas pa byas/

yos bu lo zla ba gnyis kyi tshes brgyad kyi nyin par// pho brang ta'i tu na bzhugs pa'i dus su// chos rje rin po ches mdzad pa'o// yi ge pa ni dkon mchog 'byung gnas so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// stag lo nas bzungs bu slob rnams la ni// yang nas yang du bsams zhing zhal lta gnang*// rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra// phyogs ni gar 'gro nges pa med pa yin// gnas dang sde rnams zhabs rtog byed 'dod dang*// la la dben pa brten pa spro ba dang*// chos kyis ga dar byed par 'dod pa rnams// brtson 'grus gyis la 'bad pa rab tu thon// de nas yos lo zla ba lnga pa yi// tshes grangs lnga'i tho rangs nam lang dus// zhing khams gzhan na bzhud pa'i ltas rnams byung*// cho 'phrul byung nas bstan bcos mdzad pa yod// tshes grangs bcu bzhi ti'i tu nas bteg cing*/ shang mdor ma phebs lam gyis bar du ni// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' 'od rgyun ma chad// dad ldan rnams la bskul dang bstan bcos yod// pho brang chen po shang mdor gdan phebs nas// dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa yi// yos lo zla ba drug pa'i tshe grangs ni// bcu bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yul gdugs babs tshe// mdun gyis nam mkhar bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnams// dpag med tshogs 'dug mchod pa legs par shom// gsung bzhin mchod pa sna tshogs bshams nas phul// phyag mchod bdud rtsi gsol nas zin pa dang*// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bsdus nas su// chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar gshegs par gyur// de tshe ngo mtshar ltas dang cho 'phrul du ma rnams// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' 'od 'khrigs par byung*// kha gcig gis ni nub phyogs bzhud pa mthong*// 'di ru mi 'dug gangs can khrod du 'gro// gsung nas byin brlabs mdzad cing byon pa gzigs// tshes grangs bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba'i steng*// sku lus yongs su rdzogs dang mchod rten rnams// blon po du ran the mur la sogs pa// skye bo rnams la bstan cing dad par gyur// de nas bzungs te zhag bcu'i bar du ni// bu slob rnams ni sems ni rtse gcig gis// sku gdungs mdun du legs par gsol ba btabs// mchod pa'i sprin tshogs legs par bshams nas ni// nyi shu lnga'i nyin par dus gcig tu// rgyal blon rnams dang bu slob gyur tshad kyis// rol mo du mar bcas nas gdan drangs so// chos dbyangs a ka ru dang spos gdugs dang*// tsan dan dkar dmar so so dpag med kyis// sku gdung sbyangs shing rten mchog byon pa la// sems can rnams la brtse ba'i dpal gyi thugs so// dam chos rgyun du gsung pa'i pad ljags dang*// bskyed rim brtan pa thob pa'i bcom ldan 'das// bde mchog lhan skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i sku rnams dang*// ring bsrel sna lnga dkar gser shas che dang*// lha'i phyag mtshan yig 'bru'i tshogs rnams byon// kha gcig mi'i dbang po'i phyag tu bzhugs// la la bu slob rnams kyi phyag na yod// kha gcig phyi rten nang rten nang du bzhugs// phal cher gangs can khrod du gdan drangs so// dpon chen beng ges bskul dge ba dri med 'dis// 'gro kun chos rje'i zhabs drung skye bar shog
